AGENT: I can look at that. Can you confirm your date of birth and the last four digits of your account number?
CUSTOMER: Fourteen March 1986, and 4471.
AGENT: Thank you, that matches. Your promotional discount ended on 31 May, which is why the bill rose.
CUSTOMER: That is ridiculous. I have been a customer for nine years.
AGENT: I understand. I can move you to the Flex 20 plan, which brings the bill back to what you paid before, with no new contract.
CUSTOMER: Fine, do that.
AGENT: Done. The change applies from your next bill on 1 July. Is there anything else I can help with today?
CUSTOMER: No.
AGENT: Thank you for calling Aurelia, Sanne speaking. Have a good day.
